name: Walking for Your Heart
source:
Afternoon naps don't feel good. Games aren't exciting anymore. And even your favorite snack doesn't taste like it used to!
What happened to you?! Your life is no different than the life of a caged animal!

It's time for a change! It is time to touch grass.

Get ready to visit mysterious places, face new challenges, meet unique characters, and live the most delightful moments in your journey!
And remember! What seems like a trivial choice initially, can change everything in your future.
